question: I have a diagnosis and my doctor says I should apply for the disability tax credit. Can you confirm that CRA will approve me?
generated_answer: CRA cannot confirm whether you will be approved for the disability tax credit. The disability tax credit is a benefit administered by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) and is designed to provide tax relief to individuals with disabilities or their supporting persons or spouses or common-law partners. The CRA reviews each application individually and makes a determination based on the information provided. If you have a diagnosis and your doctor has recommended that you apply for the disability tax credit, you can submit an application to the CRA. The CRA will review your application and make a determination based on the information provided. If you are approved, you may be eligible for tax relief and other benefits.
